symptom: Docker CLI and Compose are installed, but the Docker Desktop Linux engine pipe is absent, so images cannot be inspected or built.
evidence: docker info and Compose startup could not connect to dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; com.docker.service is stopped and cannot be started from the current non-elevated process.

root_cause.summary: Docker Desktop daemon is not running.

actions: Validated Docker CLI and Compose versions.
Validated sanitized Compose configuration without exposing environment values.
Queried Docker daemon connectivity and Windows service state.
Attempted to start com.docker.service; the current process lacks permission.
Rechecked the daemon after the researcher requested Docker execution; Docker Desktop Linux engine was available and Compose completed.
reusable_resolution: Start Docker Desktop interactively, wait for the Linux engine to become available, then rerun Compose with the recorded BACKEND_PORT=3002 host override.
prevention: Verify Docker Desktop daemon connectivity immediately before activating the runtime portion of a research run.
